stops.title: Installation is currently blocked
stops.caption: The actual live-media guard displays why installation is unavailable and exits 78. No installer or disk write was performed.

stops.title: Welcome home: login theme
stops.caption: Actual SDDM theme test mode. The environment has no usable desktop session, so sign-in is unavailable. This is not a successful boot or authentication test.

stops.title: Password field
stops.caption: Dummy text is masked in the real login field. The completed installer must create your local owner password; no Google or Microsoft login is required.

stops.title: Current welcome document
stops.caption: The shipped local help document rendered in host Chromium from its source, at desktop and phone widths. Native Brave/file-URL launch is not tested by this render. A first-run setup wizard remains planned.

stops.title: Your desktop
stops.caption: Actual nested Plasma desktop with the approved Rest wallpaper. The test account retains its demo palette. KDE taskbar/icons are still visible; this is not the final polished shell or a booted ISO.

stops.title: Find OREZ applications
stops.caption: Actual launcher search shows Store, Connect, Settings, Calendar, hardware tools and Welcome. Android entries exist but their consumer runtime remains deferred.

stops.title: Searchable Settings
stops.caption: Typed Bluetooth into native Settings; matching results appeared. Clearing the query and closing Settings also passed.

stops.title: Network settings
stops.caption: Native NetworkManager settings open and close. This offline container has no physical Wi-Fi radio; no connection or hotspot claim.

stops.title: Wi-Fi password controls
stops.caption: A dummy wireless credential was masked, revealed, remasked, cleared and cancelled. No connection was saved. This does not test actual Wi-Fi authentication.

stops.title: Bluetooth settings
stops.caption: The actual page correctly reports no Bluetooth adapter in the container. Target-PC pairing, audio and file transfer are pending.

stops.title: Phone connection
stops.caption: Real KDE Connect window, no paired phone. KDE Connect handles transfers/control; scrcpy provides separate consented screen mirroring. No Realme mirroring session was fabricated.

stops.title: File operations
stops.caption: A disposable text file was copied, renamed, moved to Trash and restored with Undo through the real Dolphin UI. The original and restored bytes matched. No user data or physical drive was touched.

stops.title: Tabs and split view
stops.caption: Real Dolphin tabs and two panes, showing the restored renamed file. Split/tabs visually confirmed; nested function-key automation was replaced with actual menu/button input.

stops.title: OREZ Store
stops.caption: The native Store detects installed Brave, VLC and SuperTux. VLC launched from its button. Android app entries are explicitly pending, not functional Play Store downloads.

stops.title: OREZ Calendar
stops.caption: Actual local event creation/editing, SQLite persistence, ICS export and cancellable deletion passed. No cloud account or remote request.

stops.title: Reuz clock
stops.caption: Native timezone and 12/24-hour preferences saved without changing the system clock. This is the current OREZ Reuz component, not a claim about another repository release.

stops.title: Reuz countdown
stops.caption: Start, pause, resume and completion passed. It is an application timer; suspended-PC wake and physical alarm audio are not verified.

stops.title: Reuz stopwatch
stops.caption: Start/pause, lap and reset passed. Closing active work asks for confirmation and cancellation keeps the app open.

stops.title: OREZ Ink palette
stops.caption: Real Reuz rendering with the packaged Ink palette. Both Paper and Ink were applied; the five proposed future themes are not implemented.

stops.title: Horizon wallpaper
stops.caption: Your second supplied wallpaper applied in the real desktop, then restored to Rest. A wallpaper change is not a new OS edition.

stops.title: Fullscreen VLC
stops.caption: Generated local video played. Actual Space pause/resume, mouse menu, F fullscreen on/off and Ctrl+Q passed. GPU decoding, physical audio and streaming were not tested.

stops.title: Fullscreen native game
stops.caption: SuperTux rendered at 1440×900. Captures show the player moving from x≈96 to x≈482 after Right input. This is software rendering, not an RTX benchmark, Android emulation or universal game compatibility.

stops.title: Game pause menu
stops.caption: Escape opened the actual game pause menu. Only the disposable native game session was stopped.

stops.title: Files and terminal together
stops.caption: Dolphin and Konsole arranged side by side. Minimize and restore also passed. Ordinary user UID 1500, not a privileged desktop session.

stops.title: A second workspace
stops.caption: KWin created a second workspace, switched to it, returned and removed the test workspace. The windows stayed on their original workspace.

stops.title: Restart the panel, preserve the work
stops.caption: A controlled Plasma shell restart brought the panel back while the existing Dolphin/Konsole processes remained alive. This is not kernel-crash, power-loss or disk-recovery qualification.

stops.title: Brave: honest environment limit
stops.caption: The official native Linux browser was attempted. Its sandbox could not create required nested namespaces. This report records BLOCKED, even though the vendor wrapper returned zero; no working browser or YouTube is claimed.
stops.kind: Test report — not a browser window

stops.title: AI status is visible
stops.caption: orezctl ai explicitly reports NOT ENABLED. No AI/MCP root or remote action broker is installed. Future AI must use ordinary permissions and explicit owner approval.
